Security National Bank of Sioux City Iowa IA raised its stake in shares of Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL – Free Report) by 42.1% during the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
